study: One-measurement causal nutrient identification from visible pilot plots
budget: one soil-meter assay per policy per seed; same seed and visible candidate set in each pair

selector.active: AutoRA model_disagreement_sample over two prespecified posterior-size utility models
selector.random: AutoRA random_pool over the same publicly observed samples
selector.ablation: direct public rule: select the first soil sample with a visible growth cue

active_utility_models.task_structure: one causal nutrient; a public growth-positive sample is predicted to leave one candidate after assay, negative leaves four
active_utility_models.conservative: one assay leaves four candidates regardless of public growth cue

selector.important_scope: The disagreement is over prespecified information-utility predictions, not fitted scientific response models. The benchmark's one-cause structure is an explicit assumption under test.

oracle_policy: getTaskScorecard was queried only after each selection and assay, solely for post-hoc scoring.
limits: This tests a narrow, deterministic DiscoveryWorld task, not TRONCO-01/M17/G1/G2.
The positive-growth cue is visible and the AutoRA selector encodes an explicit one-cause utility assumption; this is not a learned discovery from raw outcomes.
The task's own scoring oracle and source determine the hidden benchmark answer; results do not establish external causal validity.
TELEPORT_TO_OBJECT is used only as a harness positioning shortcut and is not counted in the assay budget.
